title: Gear-Driven Shader Alchemy: Water Bottle Transmutation Lab
description: A mechanical alchemy workstation where interlocking gears drive custom shader effects on a water bottle. The user rotates gears to mix shader parameters—chromatic aberration, iridescence, dissolve, and heat distortion—while a conservation law ensures total shader energy remains constant. Undo/redo lets the user step through transmutation states.
prompt:
Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 with GLTFLoader and OrbitControls from CDN. Load gears.glb on the left and WaterBottle.glb on the right-center of the scene. Camera at (0,1.5,4) looking at origin. Use a neutral HDR-style environment with two directional lights and ambient light.

SHADER SYSTEM: Replace the water bottle's materials with a custom ShaderMaterial. Define four shader parameters: chromaticShift (RGB offset), iridescence (view-angle color shift via fresnel), dissolveAmount (noise-based alpha cutoff with glowing edges), and heatDistortion (vertex displacement via sine waves). Each parameter ranges 0.0-1.0. Enforce a CONSERVATION LAW: the sum of all four parameters must always equal exactly 2.0. When one increases, others must proportionally decrease.

GEAR INTERACTION: Render four colored ring indicators around the gears mesh. Clicking a gear tooth region and dragging vertically adjusts one of the four shader parameters. The gears should visually rotate proportional to the active parameter's value using a uniform. MULTI-INPUT COUPLING: holding Shift while dragging locks two parameters together so they change in tandem while the other two compensate. Display parameter values as floating HUD labels using CSS overlays.

UNDO/REDO: Maintain a state history stack (max 50 entries). Each drag-release commits a state. Pressing Ctrl+Z undoes, Ctrl+Y redoes. Show step counter as 'State X/Y' in the top-right corner.

VISUAL FEEDBACK: The gears should have a metallic PBR look via MeshStandardMaterial with metalness=0.9 and roughness=0.3. Add a pulsing emissive outline (custom shader pass or emissive flicker) on whichever gear region is hovered. The bottle's dissolve edge should glow orange. Iridescence should produce rainbow fresnel. Heat distortion should wobble vertices using time uniform. Chromatic shift should offset R/G/B texture samples in the fragment shader.

Include a reset button that animates all parameters back to 0.5 each. Total interaction steps to explore all features: 10-14. Ensure smooth 60fps rendering with requestAnimationFrame loop updating time uniforms.
